# Exercise 1

Find the total number of seats on all of the planes that flew out of New York in 2013.

```{duckdb}
SELECT sum(seats) AS total_seats
FROM flights LEFT JOIN planes USING (tailnum);
```


# Exercise 2

For each month find the carrier with the worst mean arrival delay using a window function and `QUALIFY`, then find the fraction of each carrier's flights that departed more than 30 minutes late compared to the fraction over all flights using a CTE.

```{duckdb}
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT month, carrier, avg(arr_delay) AS delay
  FROM flights
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT month, carrier, round(delay, 1) AS delay
FROM monthly
QUALIFY rank() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY delay DESC) = 1
ORDER BY month;
```

```{duckdb}
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT avg(CASE WHEN dep_delay > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overall_late
  FROM flights
)
SELECT carrier,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN dep_delay > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 3) AS late,
       round(overall_late, 3) AS overall_late
FROM flights CROSS JOIN overall
GROUP BY carrier, overall_late
ORDER BY late DESC;
```
